resources.string:
Install the Phone Dialer watch app in your Pebble app, then allow the features you want below.

Dialer: enter a number on your watch.
Recent calls: browse your latest 100 calls and call back.
Favorites and Contacts: browse your address book.

Theme, main menu order and touch options are in the watch app's Settings, under Phone Dialer in the Pebble app.

Phone allows calls. Contacts enables Favorites and Contacts. Call history enables Recent calls. Data stays on your phone and paired watch.

If access was denied, use the buttons to open app settings. Some Android installers restrict call history access; see the included installation guide if Call history cannot be enabled.

Keep your Pebble phone app connected. For dual SIM phones, set a default calling SIM in Android settings or finish SIM selection on the phone. Emergency calls may require the phone dialer.
